targets.note: Right-click on an agent: Message, Open Profile, its computer, Pause, Star, Mute, Delete Agent last.
The same agent for a member: no Pause, Wake or Sleep, Delete.
Right-click on a chat: Open, Open in New Tab, Rename, Star, Mark as Unread, Mute, Archive, Delete chat last.
Right-click on a person: Message, Mark as Read or Unread, Mute.
Right-click on a channel: Open, Mark as Read, Star, Mute, Copy Link, Leave Channel.
